featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very glad to write my review of TSG Swimming Pool, @ VK Krishna Menon Academy, Borivali West.
I am member of this pool since 2022 after my son's friend recommendation.
My son and daughter both learned swimming all four types here in quick time, thanks to the coaches. Despite many kids simultaneously in pool, coaches handled them very professionally and made sure to utilise their sessions productive.
Best part about the pool is, it's not deep and we can be assured about children safety without any fear.
Pool is well maintained, clean water, clorine content is skin friendly. I never had skin tanning or irritation.
Pool management staff is courteous and professional, always ready to help. Coaches are expert and well experienced, knows how to train kids of different ages. They make sure that kids will loose fear and love water activities while learning swimming.
They also encourage kids to participate in swimming competition within TSG Pool group and various tournaments and guide kids to perform well.
If one looking for professional swimming pool with world class coaching facility, you can simply choose TSG Swimming Pool.

featured_reviews.review_text: One of the well maintained club around. With plenty of sport options with state of the art facilities. 6 badminton courts with one being matt and also Olympic size swimming pool . Many eating options and also good restaurants to dine at. The banquets halls serves well to host any functions. Lot of parking space open as well as closed. Adequately staffed and good security around.

featured_reviews.name: Shlok Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a life member of GSC for many years and overall it’s been a great place to be. The food quality is consistently good, and the gym is well-equipped with everything needed for a solid workout. The trainers and facilities are generally well maintained.

The club also offers excellent wellness amenities including steam, sauna, and other recreational facilities, which add a lot of value to the membership.

The only downside is that the gym can get quite crowded during peak hours. More importantly, health and hygiene standards in certain areas need to be taken more seriously. While the steam and sauna facilities are good, they sometimes have a lingering smell of oils and can feel a bit stuffy, especially when heavily used. More frequent cleaning, better ventilation, and closer attention to hygiene would significantly improve the overall experience.

That said, GSC continues to offer a strong overall experience, and as a life member, I feel it remains one of the better clubs in the city for fitness, dining, and family recreation.

featured_reviews.name: Amberdeep Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the Best sports club in this part of city which actually dedicates good amount of resources for sports and culturalactivities. GSC is loaded with lots of sports and general amenities. They have massive sport ground for cricket and other social events, Olympic size 10 lane swimming pool, separate pools for kids and even totally separate diving pool too. There are couple of basketball courts, multiple lawn tennis, squash and badminton courts. They even have 4 lane pistol shooting range and facilities for gymnastics, calisthenics, crossfit training, boxing and of course a big gym. There is a 500 meter walking track lined with trees and flowers making your walking experience pleasant. You can enjoy variety of food at their different restaurants and food courts. They even have a Library here with good collection of books with accessibility for non-members too. The staff here is very helpful and always there to offer their assistance. The washrooms are never far off as they are located all around the club and always clean and tidy. The club can accommodate good number of car in it's parking.

featured_reviews.name: rizwan thakur
featured_reviews.review_text: ⭐ Review / Complaint – Country Club Membership I have been a member of Country Club India Ltd, but I stopped using the club since 2023 due to the extremely poor condition of its facilities. The overall maintenance of the club has deteriorated badly. The**gym equipment is outdated and poorly maintained**, the**swimming pool hygiene is not up to standard**, the**lawn area is neglected**, and even the**restaurant quality has declined significantly**. Initially, we were paying an**annual AMC(maintenance charges)** which covered most of the facilities. However, since 2022, the club started charging**extra for basic services** like Zumba, Yoga, and other activities, which were earlier part of the membership benefits. This feels unfair and misleading. Despite all this, we continued the membership for some time only because of the club’s proximity to our residence. However, due to the continuously poor conditions, I eventually stopped going and joined another club. Now, even after clearly informing them multiple times that I am**not interested in continuing the membership**, their team keeps calling repeatedly and pressuring me to pay AMC. They have even stated that they will continue calling until payment is made. This kind of behavior feels like**harassment and extortion**. The call center staff’s tone is aggressive and unprofessional, which reflects very poor management practices. # ❌ Major Issues: * Poor maintenance of all facilities * Extra charges for previously included services * Decline in overall service quality * Continuous harassment calls for AMC payment * Unprofessional and aggressive behavior # ⚠️ Final Opinion: I would strongly**not recommend this club** to anyone. What started as a decent membership has turned into a disappointing and stressful experience due to poor upkeep and harassment for payments.
